content.text: I found a bug: an empty port (`host:`) was being accepted. Let me fix it.

p='submission/bridge.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = '''        if b":" in raw:
            host_raw, port_raw = raw.split(b":", 1)
        else:
            host_raw, port_raw = raw, b""
        host = normalize_host(host_raw)
        if host is None:
            return None
        if port_raw:
            port = parse_port(port_raw)
            if port is None:
                return None'''
new = '''        if b":" in raw:
            host_raw, port_raw = raw.split(b":", 1)
        else:
            host_raw, port_raw = raw, None
        host = normalize_host(host_raw)
        if host is None:
            return None
        if port_raw is not None:
            port = parse_port(port_raw)
            if port is None:
                return None'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
